sourcePolicy: Fineli supplies available-carbohydrate quantities only. GI evidence is stored as individual, traceable records on the glucose scale. STRONG values must be published and ISO 26642-confirmed; they support direct food and preparation matches only. Published SUPPLEMENTARY values and explicitly sourced analogues may support a low-confidence ingredient estimate when food and preparation relevance are documented. CATEGORY_MEAN values are broad proxies, never described as measurements of the named food, and force LOW confidence. Study quality and food/preparation match quality remain separate. For a missing GI match on a positive portion below 1 g available carbohydrate per serving, omission is an editorial tolerance only when all such recipe portions sum to less than 2 g per serving; the omitted carbohydrate amount is disclosed. This is not a clinical error bound. Larger known carbohydrate portions require GI evidence. The formula is an ingredient-sum estimate, not a measurement of a prepared meal. Do not copy complete source tables or substitute unsupported foods/preparations.

source.qualityEvidence: The 2021 international tables place this result in Supplemental Table 2 because of method deviations: only six participants with type 2 diabetes, no repeated reference, and 0/60/120 minute sampling. The cited source does not establish equivalence with this recipe’s water-boiled, oil-free porridge or isolate the effect of the added oil. Retain the record for the tested preparation; do not map it to water-boiled semolina porridge without supporting evidence.

records.note: GI 55 is retained for the source-tested steam-gelatinized semolina with groundnut oil. It is not an accepted GI match for water-boiled, oil-free semolina porridge; do not present it as a measurement of this recipe or its mixed meal.
